messages:
micah: Tiny schedule change: swap the demo and Q&A blocks today. Demo moves to 10:04, Q&A opens 10:19. I'll post a sticky in #lobby in 2 mins.

marco-av: Copy. Running a quick AV pass. Noticed intermittent caption drops in rehearsal - will force-reconnect caption service before go.

anya: I'll pin the agenda tweak in #lobby and include instructions to upvote questions in the Q&A thread.

riley: Can we also set expectation that we might switch to audio-only for a short bit if audio jitter spikes? People should still be able to upvote.

micah: Yes call that out in the sticky. We'll seed two leadership prompts at the start (roadmap priorities, Dedicated SLA timeline) and then open to votes.

jen: I'll join the Q&A for the first 5 minutes to answer SLA/timeline clarifications. No wording changes expected for SLAs today.

marco-av: Caption service forced restart done. Still seeing ~1s caption latency which is fine. If captions fail again, fallback is post-meeting transcript + live summary.

stream-bot: Stream monitor: ingest latency 420ms, packet loss 0.2% over 5m. Auto-failover threshold at 5% or 5s sustained gap.

marco-av: Ops fallback plan: 1) attempt camera software reconnect, 2) if camera gap >2s for 15s cut to slides-only layout, 3) if OBS crash, fail to backup ingest. Rehost command: `ssh ops@streambox "curl -X POST https://ingest-backup.internal/v1/failover?stream=all-hands"`.

anya: Sticky posted: "Agenda update + captions enabled. Demo 10:04, Q&A 10:19. Upvote questions in the thread. We may pause video briefly if audio issues."

riley: Mic swap ready if needed. Monitoring audio now at -6dB. If jitter >250ms sustained for 30s we flip to audio-only.

micah: Thanks team. After the meeting I'll compile Q&A, slide updates, and any follow-ups into #all-hands-summary. See you in 8. :rocket:
